title: Fish Audio gives its voice AI away, and charges for the latency

content_html:
Fish Audio, a Palo Alto voice-AI startup, has raised $52m in a round it still calls a seed, first reported by TechCrunch. It arrives at a company with an unusual shape. It gives its best models away, and charges for the wiring around them.

The startup is a year old. It says more than 8 million people now use its models, through either the open-weight releases or its hosted platform. The business runs at $21m in annual recurring revenue.

Give the model away, charge for the latency

Fish Audio’s logic is the open-source playbook applied to voice. It has shipped five models in a year and open-sourced three of them. Free weights and a free frontier model buy distribution among developers. Revenue comes from the enterprises that need contracts.

Even its newest model, S2.1 Pro, which it holds back from open release, is free over the API until 31 August. It clones a voice from a five-second clip, supports 83 languages, and returns first audio in about 70 milliseconds. The paid plans are where the latency and uptime guarantees live. Fish asks anyone above $1m in revenue to talk before building on the free tier, Unite.AI reported.

That is the whole business in a line. Open weights win the developers, and enterprises pay for the promises. HeyGen, LiveKit, Retell, Sanas and OpenArt already run on its APIs. A $52m “seed” at $21m in revenue shows how fast voice went from a feature to an infrastructure line item.

Voice is becoming the interface

The timing helps. Voice is turning into the default way people talk to AI, from Claude’s voice mode to the agents now fielding sales and support calls. Chief executive Rissa Cao says demand splits by use case. Avatar firms want realism, game studios want expressive characters, and voice-agent companies want low latency that still sounds human.

It is also a crowded, well-funded field. ElevenLabs carries a valuation around $22bn, and money keeps pouring into rivals like Bland. Fish’s pitch is that its own inference stack makes it far cheaper, and it claims S2.1 Pro runs at a fraction of ElevenLabs’ cost.

The library is the moat, and the risk

The asset investors are really buying is the community. Fish Audio’s voice library is user-supplied: people submit their own voices, and get paid when someone uses one. It now holds more than two million of them.

That same library is the liability. Earlier this year, creators said others had uploaded their voices without consent, and that takedowns moved slowly. Fish has since built a dedicated dispute process, and says removals now finish in under three minutes. The fix only helps after the fact, though. Nothing stops someone uploading your voice, and it stays in use until you notice and file.

Fish’s own lead investor named the problem. “A community-centric approach can only become a durable advantage if creators trust the platform,” said Coreline Ventures’ Osuke Honda, who co-led the round. Consent, transparency and attribution, he added, “must be built into the product rather than treated as afterthoughts.”

The raise funds a bet whose moat and whose risk are the same thing, and this open-consent tension runs through the wider open-weights debate too.

content_html_zh:
TechCrunch 最先报道称，帕洛阿尔托语音人工智能初创公司 Fish Audio 在一轮融资中筹集了 5200 万美元，该轮融资仍被称为种子轮。 它到达了一家形状不寻常的公司。 它赠送最好的模型，并收取模型周围的布线费用。

这家初创公司已经成立一年了。 该公司表示，现在有超过 800 万人通过开放重量版本或其托管平台使用其模型。 该业务的年度经常性收入为 2100 万美元。

放弃模型，收取延迟费用

Fish Audio 的逻辑是应用于语音的开源剧本。 它在一年内推出了五种型号，并开源了其中的三种。 自由权重和免费前沿模型购买了开发人员之间的分配。 收入来自于需要合同的企业。

即使是其最新型号 S2.1 Pro（该型号暂未公开发布）在 8 月 31 日之前也可通过 API 免费。 它从 5 秒剪辑中克隆声音，支持 83 种语言，并在大约 70 毫秒内返回第一个音频。 付费计划是延迟和正常运行时间保证的地方。 据 Unite.AI 报道，Fish 要求任何收入超过 100 万美元的人在建立免费套餐之前先进行交谈。

这就是整个业务的一条线。 开放权重赢得了开发商，企业为承诺付出了代价。 HeyGen、LiveKit、Retell、Sanas 和 OpenArt 已在其 API 上运行。 收入 2100 万美元的 5200 万美元“种子”显示了语音从功能到基础设施项目的速度有多快。

语音正在成为界面

时机有帮助。 语音正在成为人们与人工智能交谈的默认方式，从克劳德的语音模式到现在接听销售和支持电话的座席。 首席执行官 Rissa Cao 表示，需求按用例划分。 阿凡达公司想要真实感，游戏工作室想要富有表现力的角色，语音代理公司想要低延迟，但听起来仍然像人类。

这也是一个拥挤且资金充足的领域。 ElevenLabs 的估值约为 220 亿美元，资金不断涌入 Bland 等竞争对手。 Fish 的说法是，它自己的推理堆栈使其便宜得多，并且声称 S2.1 Pro 的运行成本只是 ElevenLabs 的一小部分。

图书馆是护城河，也是风险

投资者真正购买的资产是社区。 Fish Audio 的语音库是用户提供的：人们提交自己的声音，并在有人使用时获得报酬。 现在它拥有超过两百万个。

同一个图书馆是责任。 今年早些时候，创作者表示，其他人未经同意就上传了他们的声音，而且删除行动进展缓慢。 菲什此后建立了专门的争议程序，并表示现在删除工作在三分钟内即可完成。 不过，修复只能在事后才有帮助。 没有什么可以阻止有人上传您的声音，并且它会一直使用，直到您注意到并归档为止。

Fish 自己的主要投资者指出了这个问题。 “只有创作者信任该平台，以社区为中心的方法才能成为持久的优势，”本轮联合领投人、Coreline Ventures 的 Osuke Honda 表示。 他补充说，同意、透明度和归属“必须融入产品中，而不是事后才考虑。”

筹集资金的赌注，其护城河和风险是同一件事，这种公开同意的紧张关系也贯穿于更广泛的公开权重辩论中。
